name: legimini
description: Search the French-language Legimini catalogue, open detailed book pages, and discover related books.

interface.longDescription: Legimini helps readers search a French-language book catalogue, open detailed book pages, and discover related books from a selected title. Results come from the Legimini catalogue. The plugin is limited to books and does not access personal reader accounts.
defaultPrompt: Cherche Ce que le jour doit à la nuit sur Legimini
Recommande-moi des livres similaires à un roman que j'aime
Ouvre la fiche Legimini d'un livre

positive.description: Find a known French-language novel by title and return matching catalogue entries.
positive.prompt: Cherche Ce que le jour doit à la nuit dans le catalogue Legimini.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns Ce que le jour doit à la nuit by Yasmina Khadra among the first results, with a Legimini book URL and cover when available.

positive.description: Search for books using an author name.
positive.prompt: Trouve des livres de Yasmina Khadra sur Legimini.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns catalogue matches associated with Yasmina Khadra and does not invent titles absent from the returned results.

positive.description: Open a detailed book page from a Legimini book URL.
positive.prompt: Ouvre la fiche de ce livre : https://legimini.com/Livres/Ce-que-le-jour-doit-a-la-nuit-de-Yasmina-Khadra/97758
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin displays the Legimini record for book 97758, including its title, author, catalogue metadata, summary when available, and canonical Legimini URL.

positive.description: Recommend related books from a valid catalogue book.
positive.prompt: Recommande-moi trois livres proches du livre Legimini 1346862.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin uses book 1346862 as the seed and returns no more than three related catalogue books with Legimini URLs.

positive.description: Search first, then use the selected result to obtain recommendations.
positive.prompt: Trouve Ce que le jour doit à la nuit puis propose-moi des livres similaires.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin identifies the matching Legimini book, uses its catalogue ID as the recommendation seed, and returns related books without claiming access to the user's private library.

negative.description: Reject a request outside the plugin's book scope.
negative.prompt: Donne-moi la météo à Paris demain.

negative.description: Handle an unknown book identifier without inventing a book.
negative.prompt: Ouvre la fiche du livre Legimini 999999999.

negative.description: Handle an empty or unusable book search without fabricating results.
negative.prompt: Cherche le livre intitulé zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz sur Legimini.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the Legimini plugin with anonymous read-only catalogue search, book details, and related-book recommendations.

fr-FR.subtitle: Trouvez vos prochains livres
fr-FR.description: Legimini aide les lecteurs à rechercher des livres dans un catalogue francophone, à ouvrir des fiches détaillées et à découvrir des ouvrages proches d'un titre sélectionné. Les résultats proviennent du catalogue Legimini. Le plugin est limité aux livres et n'accède pas aux comptes personnels des lecteurs.
